answer: Each agent identity is minted only after an SGX/TPM enclave produces a zero-knowledge attestation of a unique sealed key and measured model; oasis is the state tree, nectar the hash anchor, and violet the consensus contract validating proofs. Forging requires compromising distinct hardware or duplicating physical silicon with divergent measurements, while registration follows an O(N^2) bonding curve and failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
